spec_match.rationale: Values, names, modes and platforms come from SafeBrowsingProtectionLevel.yaml; eligibility text follows the ChromeStatus summary (ESB only, high-confidence indicators, ephemeral).

interactive.rationale: Level/mode/platform controls regenerate the .reg / plist / defaults / JSON artifact, eligibility readout and verification steps; copy button.

blurb_alignment.rationale: Promised generator and decision readout delivered.

edge_cases.rationale: Unset policy, recommended vs mandatory per platform, NoProtection; clipboard failure fallback.

references.rationale: ChromeStatus, enterprise policy list, Chromium YAML, help centre.

runtime_evidence.rationale: Headless Chromium 153.0.8010.12 (Playwright) at 1280x800 and 360x740 DPR3 touch; console and network clean; 0px horizontal overflow (after fixes); feature-level conformance panel rendered 4 pass / 0 fail / 3 blocked. The scan itself is never observable from a page, so no verdict evidence exists by design. Five level/mode/platform combinations produced the expected artifacts (dword:00000002, -int 1, JSON 0/2, unset note); copy reported 'Copied.'. Partial: artifacts were not deployed to a managed browser here.

telemetry_health.rationale: Asserts the generated artifact contains the documented enum value.

design_system.rationale: Tokens only; eligible emerald-dark, not-eligible rose.

accessibility.rationale: Fieldset/legend radios, status-region badge, focusable labelled <pre>.

mobile_desktop_parity.rationale: Options stack at 360px; pre scrolls inside itself; 0px page overflow.

openQuestions.title: Deploy-and-verify on a managed machine
openQuestions.detail: Apply each artifact on Windows, macOS and Linux and confirm chrome://policy shows SafeBrowsingProtectionLevel with the right level and source.

guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Group related radios in fieldset/legend with visible labels; avoid custom controls when native ones work.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: All option groups are fieldset+legend native radios/checkboxes; range input paired with an <output>.

guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Use navigator.clipboard.writeText from a user gesture, report success/failure, and offer a manual fallback.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Copy button reports Copied / failure reason and tells users to select the text manually when the API is missing or rejects.

guidanceConsulted.query: responsive control panel without horizontal overflow
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Collapse grids on narrow viewports, wrap long tokens, keep 44px targets.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Single-column below 760-900px, overflow-wrap:anywhere on code and enum names, 44px controls; measured 0px overflow at 360px.

guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Announce discrete outcomes in polite status/log regions; native labelled controls; visible focus.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Outcomes in role=status/role=log; native buttons, radios, checkboxes with visible labels and focus-visible outlines.

summary: Real SafeBrowsingProtectionLevel artifact generator with an honest who-is-eligible readout.
